paragraphs: Mentioned at the end of Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia, chapter 4, in the formula “Yaakov Amsonya recited”; Yuchasin reads Omsayi.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: ב״מ ספ״ד explicitly gives Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia end-of-chapter 4, without independently checked named text.
תני belongs with Yaakov as recited/taught, not in-the-name-of-a-baraita; the formula is kept whole across the line break without assigning a professional role.
Yuchasin’s Omsayi is Hyman’s attributed alternative to Amsonya, without identifying an edition/author or independently collating. No personal title is supplied.
